fields.title: Technical Points
fields.hint:
Key Technical Points of the product.
Example: 'Waterproof up to 50m', 'Battery life: 10 hours'

fields.title: Small Description
fields.hint:
Brief Product Description. Summarize key features.
Example: 'Compact and lightweight design, perfect for travel.'

fields.title: Long Description
fields.hint:
Detailed Product Description. Include specifications, benefits, and more.
Example: 'This camera features a 24.2MP APS-C sensor, capable of capturing high-quality images in various lighting conditions. Its compact form factor makes it an ideal travel companion.'
